title: Add data quality checks + anomaly alerts for unit economics pipeline
author: Caleb Johnson
description:
Context: We’ve seen multiple cases where the Unit Economics dashboard showed sudden improvements or drops that were actually pipeline issues (most commonly ingestion lag or missing dimensions), e.g. the “hours missing” incident thread and earlier streaming token undercount investigations. This PR adds first-pass data quality checks and anomaly alerts for the hourly unit economics aggregation outputs so we can detect regressions quickly and avoid Finance/Product interpreting bad data.

What this PR does: (1) Completeness checks per hour: verifies presence of expected rows for core dimensions (region, customer_tier, model) and flags coverage below threshold; (2) Missing dimension checks: alerts when unknown/NULL region or customer_tier exceeds a configured percentage; (3) Token-volume anomaly checks: compares output_tokens to a trailing baseline (7d median by {region,tier} and global) and alerts on sudden drops/spikes; (4) Freshness checks: alerts if the latest successfully published hour is older than N minutes; (5) Emits standardized alert events to PagerDuty + Slack via our existing “observability-pack” sink, with runbook links and dashboards.

Notes/constraints: - These checks operate on the post-aggregation tables (warehouse) rather than raw metering to keep signal stable and avoid cardinality explosions. - Baselines are computed on “finance_view” (rate-card-stable) by default; “live_view” is available but not used for alerting to avoid false positives during backfills. - Thresholds are intentionally conservative in v1; tuning will happen after a week of dogfooding.

Testing: - Added unit tests for threshold logic and baseline computation edge cases (new region/tier appearing, backfill window overlaps). - Ran ad-hoc validation in staging by simulating missing tiers and forcing a token drop.

Rollout plan: Merge behind ECON_DQ_ALERTS_ENABLED flag default OFF in prod. SRE (Sean) will enable for internal dogfood after we observe 48h of clean staging behavior. Finance will be notified once alert noise is acceptable.

Follow-ups: - Add per-model-version anomaly checks once model_id normalization is fully rolled out everywhere. - Add explicit detection for streaming/non-streaming parity drift once the streaming metering canary is fully green for a full week.

Refs: ENG-8429, ENG-8430; incident context: “metric drop / hours missing” + internal backfill performance issues; runbook draft will land separately (ENG-8435).
commits: econ/dq: add hourly completeness + freshness validators
econ/dq: add baseline anomaly detector for output_tokens
alerts: wire econ dq alerts into slack + pager routing
tests: add validator tests + fixtures for backfill windows
docs: add runbook links in alert payload + README updates
changed_areas: warehouse/migrations/ (materialized helper view for expected-dimension coverage)
notable_snippets: Validator thresholds (defaults): missing_region_pct <= 0.5%, missing_tier_pct <= 0.2%, freshness_lag_minutes <= 90, token_drop_alert if < 60% of 7d median for 2 consecutive hours (global) OR < 40% for any region+tier bucket with >= 1M baseline tokens/hour.
Alert payload includes: check_name, window_start_hour, affected_dimensions (top offenders), observed vs expected, confidence tag (baseline_volume), and runbook_url.
review_conversation: Logan Wright: Can we ensure we’re not alerting on backfills? We’ve had noisy alerts when someone reruns a day. Also, please confirm this reads from the same materialized views the dashboard uses.

Caleb Johnson (author): Good call. Added suppression when backfill_mode=true (set by the job runner) and when publish_hour < now-6h. Also updated to read from unit_econ_hourly_finance_mv (same as dashboard finance view).
Nadia Rahman: The token anomaly check should use output_tokens, not total_tokens. Also ensure streaming vs non-streaming isn’t double-counted in the baseline.
Caleb Johnson (author): Updated to output_tokens only; baseline groups by streaming_flag=ANY (aggregated) to avoid split baselines and double counting. Added a test for mixed streaming hours.
Allison Grant: For paging, can we route to #eng-platform and only page on freshness + severe drops? Minor missing-dimension should be Slack-only initially.
Caleb Johnson (author): Implemented severity levels: SEV2 pages on freshness breach and global token drop >50% for 2h; everything else Slack-only. Routing added to the YAML and documented.
Sean Gallagher: Please add a stable runbook link and ensure the alert payload has enough context to debug quickly (top offending regions/tiers). Also keep cardinality under control in alert labels.
Caleb Johnson (author): Added runbook_url (points to internal doc stub) and included top_k offenders in the message body (not labels). Labels limited to check_name + env only.
Mei Lin: Warehouse query looks like it could scan too much. Can we precompute expected dimension coverage per hour?
Caleb Johnson (author): Added helper view partitioned by hour and changed validator to hit that view. Staging query time dropped from ~18s to ~2.4s.
Sean Gallagher: Approved once the prod flag is default OFF and we have a clear enablement plan.
Caleb Johnson (author): Confirmed ECON_DQ_ALERTS_ENABLED defaults OFF; added rollout note + checklist.
Approvals: Logan Wright, Allison Grant, Sean Gallagher
merge_summary: Merged data quality validators and alerting wiring for the unit economics hourly pipeline. Alerts are gated behind ECON_DQ_ALERTS_ENABLED (OFF by default) and routed with conservative paging thresholds to reduce noise during initial dogfood.
release_notes: Internal: Added data completeness/freshness/anomaly checks for unit economics pipeline with Slack/PagerDuty alerts (flagged OFF by default).
